title: Herb Infused Tunisian Fish Pasta
description: A charred and shattering Tunisian dish featuring sashimi-cut fish, tagliatelle, and a blend of herbs, all paleo-friendly and served in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine parsley, cilantro, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the herb infusion.
Season the sashimi-cut fish with salt and pepper, then brush with the herb infusion.
Grill the fish for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the tagliatelle according to the package instructions, then set aside.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of tagliatelle on a banana leaf, then top with a piece of grilled fish.
Drizzle the remaining herb infusion over the top of the fish and pasta.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
To add a charred and shattering element, grill the banana leaf for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until it is slightly charred and crispy.
